paper_id: SeMi_ When Imbalanced Semi-Supervised Learning Meets Mining Hard Examples
title: SeMi: When Imbalanced Semi-Supervised Learning Meets Mining Hard Examples
motivation: 现有CISSL方法关注数据集重平衡,但忽视了hard examples提升模型性能的巨大潜力
problem_framing: 把hard examples挖掘定义为提升不平衡SSL性能的关键杠杆,并提出三个核心发现来刻画问题
key_insight: 通过entropy-based在线挖掘+置信度衰减记忆库+伪标签增强三管齐下,可在低阈值下利用hard examples并保持伪标签可靠性
method_signature: OHEML+PLCE(平衡置信衰减记忆库)+解耦分类器的端到端训练
evidence_for_taste: hard examples are often from tail classes
making it difficult to fully harness the power of unlabeled data
lowering the confidence threshold can enable access to more samples but increases their uncertainty
thinking_moves: 从利用率低于80%的观察出发,反推出hard examples未被充分利用的现状
将high confidence threshold的危害具象化为:拒绝tail class样本参与学习
通过entropy与confidence的对比关系建立hard example识别标准
先降低阈值获得更多样本,再通过reweighting和certainty enhancement弥补不确定性增加的问题
区分三类样本:easy/hard/ultra-hard并设计差异化学习策略
在reversed scenario( unlabeled minority主导)上验证方法优势,贴近现实分布
